verdict.rationale: The Inference API docs say generated clients are distributed through the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems, which implies a published Protobuf schema (a machine-readable equivalent of OpenAPI). However, no evidence says the spec file itself can be downloaded, and nothing indicates an OpenAPI document for the CKS or other APIs. missing for 10: explicit downloadable OpenAPI or .proto spec file, spec coverage for the CKS cluster API and other APIs, documented download location or URL, independent hands-on confirmation

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Clients are available for the Connect, gRPC, and Protobuf ecosystems across languages including Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Rust, and Swift.
you can install a generated client instead of writing HTTP calls by hand.
